page.layout: One page of running text, one column across the full width. Running head at the top, page number 203 at the top right. Gathering signature at the bottom right. No margin notes or footnotes.

main_text.p: siani[?] gregis non animarum zelus, non diuinae ue-ritatis promulgatio. Admonuit nihilominus primum callidissima vulpes, paratis interim adver-sus illos militaribus copiis, ne contra Ecclesiae di-gnitatem quicquam molirentur: hoc est, ne Siciliae regnum, quod ille affectauerat, sibi ac suis Cardi-nalibus auferrent. Qui tamen heroicos gerentes animos, accersitis e Nuceria Saracenis atq; aliis, copiae[?] Papales, nihil tale metuentes, apud fossam aggressi, partim ceperunt, partim trucidarunt. In-terea Alexander, excommunicato Manfredo, Anagniam profectus, Octavianum Vbaldina gentâ[?] ortum; Ecclesiae Romanæ Cardinalem, Neapolim misit: qui Neapolitanos contra eundem Manfre-dum in fide confirmaret, pollicitus se breui Cam-panis omnibus ac Neapolitanis auxilium allatu-rum. Sed Manfredus non contentus Neapolitanos solum vexare, in Hetruria quoq; factiones move-bat, maxim-vero Florentiæ, ubi placuit Guelphos reducere, qui Gibellinorum conatibus resisterent. Sic est Italia tota, grauibus odiis ac maximis tu-multibus & bellis horribiliter exagitata. Manfredus autem, qui Conradum Siciliae regem veneno extinxerat, Panormi rex declaratus, conducto mi-litum[?] legatum Apostolicum magnis cladibus attri-buit, [illegible, ~20 letters]

page.notes: Heavy wear and fading in the lower lines and the bottom left corner. The last line is largely illegible. Show-through from the reverse, and a faint stain at the bottom left, are not transcribed. Doubtful readings: "siani[?]" at the line start (possibly a fragment of "Christiani" cut off at the scan edge), "copiae[?]" (the printed form looks like "topiae"), "gentâ[?]" (the abbreviation over the a is unclear), "mi-litum[?]" (the word after the hyphen is faint). The running head is read as "ACTIS LIBER VI."; "VI." may be a division number and not part of the title. The signature "E" at the bottom right may be partly obscured.
